provider.name: International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses
provider.organization_type: global virus taxonomy, nomenclature, classification, proposal, metadata, report, governance, and release authority
provider.description: The International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses develops and maintains the official global taxonomy and nomenclature of viruses, viroids, satellites, viriforms, and related agents within its scope. ICTV publishes approved taxonomy releases, the Master Species List, the Virus Metadata Resource, online report chapters, formal taxonomy proposals, nomenclatural rules, and governance documents.
institutional_context: Global virology, taxonomy, nomenclature, and sequence-database community

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting ICTV taxonomy, Master Species List, Virus Metadata Resource, report chapters, proposals, ratification records, nomenclatural code, governance, methods, identifiers, downloads, APIs, source repositories, licenses, citations, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: ICTV, its Executive Committee, subcommittees, study groups, approved taxonomy releases, Master Species List, Virus Metadata Resource, report chapters, ratified proposals, and cited sequence databases remain authoritative for virus taxon names, classification, nomenclature, metadata, versions, and citations.
